_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits inside Disbelief; coil base-rate and muted leverage/flows favor holding the rung until a clear breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward is HOLD/Disbelief coil; narrative is flow-negative without a phase call; consensus keeps analyst HOLD
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G holds 50-62, funding near flat, 30d momentum muted, ETF flows absent
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G >63 with ETF inflows and funding expansion (up to Hope), or CVD/momentum collapse with F&G <47 (down to Complacency)
